label: Levels A and B (software and conservation) plus a partial level C (one published dataset). Not field validation of the detector.
history: First run: 62 passed, 1 failed. The failing assertion was a test-design error (2% tolerance applied to noisy readings); it was split into a noise-free exact check and a noisy check. No model code changed.

Milestone 3 (2026-11-11): dashboard app.py with 6 headless tests. First dashboard test run: 1 failure (an invalid icon character crashed the BATCH LOW message); fixed in app.py.
Milestone 4 (2026-11-11): economics rework with 4 new tests. First run: 2 failures from one bug (an array comparison in the payback formula); fixed.

Milestone 7 (2026-11-11): fixes from the independent technical review (short-run verdict, time-step guard, stored baseline from an earlier batch, input checks, evaporation cap) with 4 new tests.
